claim_text: Grouped-query attention lets several queries share one key and value, so the KV cache grows with the number of KV heads

spec.explain: Toy grouped-query attention from 2305.13245: query blocks share one key-value block. Watch q_heads and cache_ratio to see the KV cache grow with KV heads, not queries.

questions.q: Set kv to 1: what happens to the queries? Do you expect the query heads to shrink too?
questions.why: misconception that fewer KV heads means fewer queries

questions.q: Set group to 1: what happens to q_heads?
Set kv to 8: what happens to q_heads?
questions.why: reads query count at max KV heads

questions.q: Set group to 8: what happens to cache_ratio?
questions.why: reads cache saving at max sharing
